# Game-icons archery effect

The source SVG files in this directory are distributed under Creative Commons
Attribution 3.0:

- `archery-target.svg`: “Archery target” by Lorc
  - Source: https://game-icons.net/1x1/lorc/archery-target.html
- `dart.svg`: “Dart” by Delapouite
  - Source: https://game-icons.net/1x1/delapouite/dart.html
- License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
- Downloaded: 2026-08-10

Runtime derivatives are stored in `assets/ui/effects/` as `shengji_target.png` and
`shengji_dart.png`. They were rasterized to transparent 128×128 PNG files; Bevy applies
the LeoCard theme colors at runtime. These modifications do not imply endorsement by the
original artists.
